description: Reports and controls the pull request gate (gatekeepers/pr) for the gated GitHub repositories
(the allowed folders marked pr_gated): whether its service is running, and for each gated
project's open PRs whether each is blocked
(build, tests, documentation, or a quiz waiting, with its link) or may merge.
With action history it lists past assessments (quizzes)
with their pull request, time, outcome and attempts.
With action start it starts the gate's own service (pr-gate) when it is not running.
Only the user can stop or restart the gate.

params.name: action
params.description: status (default): open pull requests; history: past assessments; start: start the gate's service if it is not running

params.name: project
params.description: Only this gated project: its allowed folder name, e.g. core_dump; omit it for all

params.name: pr
params.description: Only this pull request number (for status or history), of project when several are gated; omit it for all
